config.craftable.server.partial_executio: NEVER: no partial crafting. CONFIRM: review first. EXPLICIT_SAFE: double-press to make available materials; more complex crafts still need confirmation. Pressing the craft key once never makes only part of a recipe.
config.craftable.server.surplus_delivery: REQUIRE_SPACE: all items must fit in your inventory. DROP_OVERFLOW: the items you set out to craft must fit; other leftover items that do not fit will be dropped and may be lost.
Counted in whole recipes: crafting sticks once gives four sticks. Steps used to make the ingredients also have a limit.
config.craftable.client.partial_policy.t: NEVER: no partial crafting. CONFIRM: review first. EXPLICIT_SAFE: double-press to make available materials; more complex crafts still need confirmation. World restrictions still apply.
config.craftable.client.allow_surplus_dr: Drop leftover items that do not fit
When off, all items must fit in your inventory. When on, leftover items can only be dropped if the world settings allow it.
config.craftable.client.double_press_mil: Default 350; range 150–800. Release the key between presses; key repeat does not count.
